name: Booxi
description_en:
Booxi is a retail customer-interaction platform covering scheduled appointments, store events and walk-in queues. Its current pricing page targets brands with ten or more stores, making store-network operations a more accurate identity than a generic personal calendar.

The evaluation is about how a customer moves from an online booking or queue check-in to service by the right associate, while headquarters controls common rules. Vendor conversion and sales figures are not treated as measured outcomes in this profile.
description_zh:
Booxi 是零售客户互动平台，覆盖预约到店、门店活动和临时到访排队。当前定价页面向拥有十家以上门店的品牌，因此用连锁门店运营描述它，比通用个人日历更准确。

评估重点是客户怎样从线上预约或排队签到，进入合适店员提供的服务，同时由总部控制共同规则。本文不把厂商的转化率和销售数字当作已实测结果。

core_features.explanation_en: Store teams can see scheduled and walk-in demand together with shared-resource effects on waiting.
core_features.explanation_zh: 门店团队可一起查看预约和临时到访需求，以及共享资源对等待的影响。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure availability, services and questions for a branded booking journey.
core_features.explanation_zh: 为品牌预约流程配置可用性、服务及问题。

core_features.explanation_en: The Standard plan explicitly adds API access and webhooks.
core_features.explanation_zh: Standard 套餐明确加入 API 访问及 Webhook。

Booxi describes both scheduled appointments and walk-ins, and queue assignment may account for consultant skills and availability. This is an illustrative retail scenario, not a tested installation.

sections.title_en: Example: advice booked online, service in store
sections.title_zh: 示例：线上预约咨询、到店接受服务
sections.en:
A beauty retailer could let a customer choose a consultation and store, capture the reason for the visit, then place the arrival into the store team’s service flow. Booxi describes both scheduled appointments and walk-ins, and queue assignment may account for consultant skills and availability. This is an illustrative retail scenario, not a tested installation.

Demonstrate an associate absence, a late arrival and a walk-in requesting the same shared room. Inspect staff assignments and the customer status page. Queue estimates change with traffic and resources; a displayed estimate is not a guaranteed service start time.
sections.zh:
美妆零售商可以让客户选择咨询与门店，记录到访原因，再将到店客户放入门店服务流程。Booxi 同时介绍预约和临时到访，队列分配可以考虑顾问技能及可用性。这是零售说明场景，未经实际安装测试。

建议演示店员缺勤、客户迟到和临时客户同时需要共享房间，检查店员分配与客户状态页。等待预估会随客流及资源变化，因此预估时间不是保证的服务开始时间。

sections.title_en: Queue entry and assignment are separate steps
sections.title_zh: 入队与分配是不同步骤
sections.en:
The queue page describes self check-in using an in-store QR code or booking widget, a mobile status page, notifications, and optional automatic assignment. Staff can reprioritize and reassign work. That flexibility makes the chosen service policy part of implementation: first arrival, specialist skill and priority-customer treatment can produce different orders.

Write down the intended rules and show staff what happens when no qualified associate is available. Public marketing does not document every retry, stale-estimate or offline behavior. Obtain the failure procedure and escalation route for a busy store before rollout.
sections.zh:
排队页介绍通过店内二维码或预约组件自助签到、手机状态页、通知，以及可选自动分配。员工可调整优先级和重新分配。因此，服务政策本身是实施的一部分：先到顺序、专业技能及重点客户待遇可能产生不同顺序。

应写明预期规则，并向员工展示没有合格店员可用时如何处理。公开营销页面没有说明所有重试、预估过期或离线行为。上线前应确认繁忙门店的故障处理和升级联系路径。

sections.title_en: Calendars, billing period and integration tier
sections.title_zh: 日历数、计费周期与集成档位
sections.en:
The page lists Essential with ten calendars, Standard with twenty, and Custom with a flexible count. In the dollar-denominated annual-billing view Essential and Standard show 179 and 475 per month; monthly billing shows 209 and 550. Currency selectors also include CAD and EUR, so a selected-currency quote is necessary and no universal USD amount is normalized here.

Standard adds API access, real-time webhooks, dedicated onboarding and integration support. Custom adds enterprise support/security options including SAML. Do not assume those capabilities are included in Essential because they appear elsewhere on the website. Clarify what counts as a calendar, additional calendars, messaging costs, module coverage and the contract term with sales.
sections.zh:
页面列出 Essential 含十个日历、Standard 含二十个、Custom 数量可协商。以美元符号显示的年付视图中，前两档月均为 179 和 475；月付视图为 209 和 550。货币选择器还含 CAD 和 EUR，因此需要指定货币的报价，本文不归一成通用 USD 金额。

Standard 加入 API、实时 Webhook、专门入门协助及集成支持；Custom 加入企业支持和 SAML 等安全选项。不能因为官网其他页面提到这些能力，就认定 Essential 包含。应向销售确认日历计数、额外日历、消息费用、模块覆盖及合同期限。

sections.title_en: Prepare store governance and data handoffs
sections.title_zh: 准备门店治理与数据交接
sections.en:
Begin with one representative store: services, employees, resources, operating hours, visitor questions and role permissions. Decide which settings headquarters standardizes and which a store can change. The appointment page describes real-time availability edits, while the pricing page describes multi-location governance and roles.

For integration, map booking and customer identifiers before connecting CRM or commerce tools. A webhook is a notification channel, not proof that a downstream CRM update completed. Ask for an event replay and deduplication design appropriate to your receiver. No API call, load test or permission test was run in this research.
sections.zh:
先选一家有代表性的门店，准备服务、员工、资源、营业时间、客户问题及角色权限。决定总部统一哪些设置、门店可修改哪些设置。预约页介绍实时调整可用性，定价页介绍多地点治理和角色。

集成前先映射预约与客户标识，再连接 CRM 或电商工具。Webhook 是通知渠道，不能证明下游 CRM 更新已完成。应要求适用于接收端的事件重放及去重设计。本次研究未调用 API，也未执行负载或权限测试。

sections.title_zh: 零售服务编排与合同范围
sections.en:
Booxi merits investigation when appointments and walk-ins compete for the same store people and resources across a network. A solo consultant primarily needing one booking link should assess whether the network-oriented commercial scope fits. The three interaction modes belong to one platform, but the precise modules in an offer must be confirmed.

The read sources describe a managed retail platform. They do not establish a self-hosting package or a permissive software licence. Security and compliance statements are vendor claims; no certification audit, residency determination or contractual SLA review was performed here.
sections.zh:
当预约和临时到访共同占用连锁门店的人力与资源时，Booxi 值得考察。主要需要单个预约链接的独立顾问，应判断面向门店网络的商业范围是否适合。三种互动模式属于同一平台，但具体报价包含哪些模块仍需确认。

已读来源介绍托管零售平台，不能证明有自托管软件包或宽松软件许可。安全合规陈述属于厂商说法，本文未执行认证审核、数据驻留判断或合同 SLA 审阅。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Calendar definition, extra calendars, SMS fees, paid module coverage, offline operation, recovery and contractual licence need confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 日历定义、额外日历、短信费、付费模块覆盖、离线运行、恢复及合同许可需确认。

research_gaps.en: No store, queue, payment, role or API behavior was tested; promotional revenue and conversion metrics were not adopted.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试门店、队列、支付、角色或 API 行为；未采用宣传中的营收和转化指标。
